full_prompt_en: The image is a square Japanese woodblock-inspired painting of a dark heron standing before a large pale moon over still water. A muted gray-brown sky fills most of the background, carrying fine paper grain and scarcely visible horizontal variations. The moon is a broad warm cream disk placed left of center, its edge slightly doubled on the left and softened by the textured surface. Below it, a thin dark bank or waterline crosses the lower part of the frame. The heron stands just right of center, overlapping the lower right side of the moon. Its compact rounded body is nearly black, with a narrow pale throat and cheek, a long pointed bill aimed left, and thin legs descending to the shallow surface. A few dark strokes suggest separate feathers at the tail. The bird's feet meet a small concentrated black patch; its dim reflection extends downward into a deepening gray wash. Tiny ripples and interrupted horizontal marks spread outward on either side, keeping the water quiet rather than glossy. Two small red seal-like marks and a short vertical signature sit in the open field away from the bird. The palette is highly restrained: warm ivory against taupe and charcoal, with red confined to the small marks. Light appears to come from the luminous circular form, while the bird remains a flat dark silhouette with only a few subtle tonal shifts. Broad empty areas give the single animal and low horizon room to breathe. The composition rests on the contrast between one large pale circle and one small dense shape, held together by soft grain, shallow reflection, and stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、带日本木版画气息的绘画：一只暗色鹭鸟立在静水上方一轮大淡月之前。低饱和灰褐天空占据背景大部，带细密纸纹和几乎不可察觉的横向变化。月亮是一块偏左的大暖奶油色圆盘，左缘略有重影，表面纹理使边缘柔和。其下，一道细暗岸线或水线横过画幅下部。鹭鸟立在中央稍右处，压住月亮右下部。它圆而紧凑的身体近乎黑色，喉部与脸颊有窄浅色区，长尖喙朝左，细腿落向浅水。几道暗笔提示尾部散开的羽毛。鸟足碰到一小块集中的黑色区域，暗淡倒影向下伸入逐渐加深的灰色晕染。细小波纹与断续横痕向两侧展开，使水面安静而不耀亮。两处细小红色印记和一列短短的竖向题字远离鸟，留在开阔区域。色盘极为克制：暖象牙白对灰褐与炭黑，红色只留给小印记。光似乎来自明亮的圆形，而鸟主要保持平面的暗剪影，仅有少量微妙调子变化。大片留白给独鸟和低低的水平线留下呼吸空间。构图以一大块浅圆和一小块浓暗形体的对比为核心，由柔和颗粒、浅淡倒影与静谧连在一起。
style_prompt_en: A restrained woodblock-like painting surface combines broad flat color fields with delicate tonal washes and visible fine paper grain. A large warm ivory circle occupies generous muted gray-brown space, while a compact charcoal silhouette creates the strongest contrast. Edges alternate between crisp cut shapes and soft rubbed transitions; a faint doubled contour adds a hand-printed irregularity. Sparse narrow horizontal strokes establish a shallow plane near the bottom, and a softened mirrored patch sinks into a darker wash. Light is organized through the pale field against near-black mass rather than through elaborate modeling. Tiny vermilion accents remain isolated within wide quiet areas. The overall rhythm is asymmetrical, spacious, and still, with each dark mark carrying weight against the surrounding emptiness.
style_prompt_zh: 克制的木版画式绘画表面结合大片平涂色区、细腻的明暗晕染与可见的细纸纹。一块暖象牙白大圆占据宽敞的低饱和灰褐空间，紧凑的炭黑剪影形成最强对比。边缘在清脆的裁切形状与柔和擦染过渡间交替，隐约重叠的轮廓带来手工套印的不齐。稀疏而窄的横痕在下部建立浅薄平面，柔化的镜像暗块沉入更深的晕染。光主要由浅色区域对近黑色块的关系组织，而非繁复塑形。细小朱红点缀孤立地留在宽阔安静的区域中。整体节奏不对称、开阔而静止，每道暗痕都在周围空白中具有重量。
theme_en: A dark heron standing before a pale moon over still water
theme_zh: 暗色鹭鸟立于静水上方的淡月前
name: Koson Ohara
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
